why: Each picture described in one sentence, the sentence drawn again. It drifted to a fairytale.
A woman reading a letter at a kitchen table. That's all it was.
A princess, a glowing cottage, roses and floating light. Nobody asked for any of it.

step: Elevated: the drift, word by word
why: Every word new since the round before is set in rose; the rounds fan out as a deck of cards.
